name: Nix Package Manager via Determinate Systems Installer
description: Installs the Nix package manager and optionally a flake

version.description: You can pin to a specific version of Determinate Nix Installer. if you pin the installer version, you'll also indirectly pin to the associated nix version.

flakeUri.description: Optional URI to a Nix Flake to install in using 'home-manager switch' after Nix is installed.

extraConfig.description: Extra Nix configuration to be written directly to nix.conf file.
